lead.t: Macrophages and microglial cells are the cells infected by HIV in the central nervous system.

snip.t: Macrophages and microglial cells are the cells infected by HIV in the central nervous system.
HIV can infect a variety of immune cells such as CD4+ T cells, macrophages, and microglial cells.
| Neuritic (senile) plaques | Focal spherical collections of dystrophic neurites around central Aβ core · 20–200 μm · microglial cells + reactive astrocytes at periphery |
